title: The State of AI Ethics Report, Volume 6
benchmark_measurement: Stereotypical dialogue allocation based on the religion of the actors in a generated play script.
findings: The paper reports on an AI-assisted play where outputs from GPT-3 were found to be problematic, with stereotypical dialogue allocation based on the religion of the actors, contributing to outright homophobia and racism.
